decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a sharp multi-sample jump near the end of the first window (indices 538–544) with large, asymmetric displacement across N/E/U and no immediate return; (2) a sustained drift beginning around index 685 in the third window, with coherent motion in N and E over ~40 samples without reversal.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt upward jump in N and E (e.g. index ~538–540: N from ~1 to ~12, E from ~1 to ~-6), followed by sustained high-amplitude oscillation in all components; U also jumps sharply (~-1 to ~12). The change is not symmetric across axes and lacks an obvious return within the window.

After a period of relatively stable motion (indices ~620–680), a gradual but persistent drift appears in N and E starting around index 685, with N rising from ~28 to ~30 and E increasing from ~6 to ~8 over ~30 samples; U shows a concurrent slow decline. No clear reversal or platform is evident, but the trend is distinct against prior noise level.
